title: Choose the visual world for Dash AI's OSS homepage
question: The roll assigned the Thumb-Index Reference Volume. Keep it, take the pick or an alternate, or re-roll. All worlds keep the Dash AI navy and violet slash.

options.label: Thumb-Index Reference Volume
options.thesis: One reference volume where every project and every section is a notched tab you can thumb straight to.
options.viewport: A tall navy tab stack cut into the right edge (Search, DocMyRepos, openspec-hud, OKF, Self-host); the left page carries a huge headline and a working search line showing a highlighted hit from real docs; GitHub button sits on the first tab-height line.
options.risk: Turns into a skeuomorphic book if the tabs are drawn instead of working as sticky section navigation.

raised.raise: Each tab shows only what is ahead: one destination, one label, active tab repainted instantly, never a menu.

options.label: The Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: ISO engineering drawing sheets: zone grid, title block, revision table
options.thesis: Every project is a controlled drawing with a title block, because DocMyRepos' own OKF metadata card is one.
options.viewport: A framed sheet with A-D / 1-6 zone marks; the real product screenshot sits as the drawing, the title block bottom right states PROJECT, TYPE, LICENSE MIT, STATUS and the GitHub action.
options.risk: Close to the blueprint look dev tools already use, and the title-block grid can feel cold if the type is timid.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: The org is a terminal and each repo is a gate, signed band by band.
options.viewport: Full-width navy sign bands: 'Search all docs →', 'DocMyRepos · Live · MIT →', 'openspec-hud · Coming soon'; huge gate-style labels.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the one search box and per-repo spaces are literally wayfinding. The source's yellow is translated to the brand violet; loses narrowly on clarity because bands carry little proof.
options.risk: Reads as signage novelty when there is no screenshot to prove the product.

options.label: Glyph-Grid Scene
options.thesis: The page is one monospace grid where the repo's docs tree renders as living glyph density.
options.viewport: A character-grid field of the docs/ tree rendered as density glyphs, with the headline and GitHub action living inside the same grid.
options.case: Developers identify with it instantly; clarity suffers because the scene is decoration unless it renders real docs structure.
options.risk: Terminal-monoculture: a dev tool dressed as a terminal is the predictable choice.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.case: Fuses poorly: there are no real counts to show (no stars, users or benchmarks), and orange overrides the brand.
options.kept: Fixed digit positions that change in place, a discipline for any stat or status that does appear.

options.label: Wildstyle Blackbook
options.thesis: The name knitted into one interlocked mass.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an illegible name fails product clarity, and the cream ground is off-brand.
options.kept: The small fast version beside the full one: the Dash mark alone next to the full lockup.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: A white field with color only at the edges.
options.viewport: Quiet white page with a thin colored fringe.
options.case: Fuses weakly: nothing in the product maps to atmosphere optics.
options.kept: Chroma confined to edges while text stays achromatic: a rule for how violet is rationed.
options.risk: Pretty but says nothing about docs search.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.thesis: Painted planes sliding at different speeds.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the world is a forest mood with no link to documentation.
options.kept: Depth by differing scroll speeds for screenshot layers.
options.risk: Picture of a world, not a website.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean open-source product page: headline, screenshot, feature grid, quickstart.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and GitHub button left, DocMyRepos screenshot right, three feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other OSS landing pages by design.
